verdict.rationale: The evidence confirms that Greenhouse interviews use scorecards with defined questions: the AI Notetaker maps transcribed notes directly to scorecard questions to speed up submission. That confirms scorecards exist, but it only glances at the structure the story describes. Missing for 10: defined attributes per interview stage, focused rubrics or attribute assignments per interviewer, cross-candidate comparison of scorecard results, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
